description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

Fruit ripens, flowers bloom and branches sprout leaves sprout in your presence. When you move you leave a trail of lush vegetation and colourful flowers and fruits in your wake. If you stay in place however things will become overripe and then start to rot rapidly. By touching a living creature and succeeding with a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test you can Heal them for Fellowship + SL Wounds. They will have to pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or become afflicted by one of the symptoms in the table below for 1d10 days. See @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.journals.JournalEntry.NS3YGlJQxwTggjRX.JournalEntryPage.9ktDn8cwZj3KZWCH]{Diseases} for more information about the symptoms.
